core.body:
When the researcher starts studio Ask, its agent may request review without a role marker. The old request path then records the summary as author-confirmed. Agent-name markers and verifier gates now leave summaries unconfirmed. Recorded drafts, changed drafts and unknown authorship have distinct labels. Review-now freezes the current work without confirming the summary. Existing bound snapshots remain unchanged.

Scoped Prover/Decomposer contexts may import a literature result under their current node. Core checks parsed kind, parent and reassignment arguments; this adds no authority to accept the result or conduct Reference review. An existing imported result can be attached by a scoped Decomposer, while local proof work cannot be added through that new permission.

Accepted ADR-0021 text remains historical. [Proposed ADR-0023](https://github.com/DengZhiyuan-math/proof-cli/blob/f77d902ba2f8ccb6b99733d449e53fad85bb897e/docs/adr/0023-reader-pursue-and-review-corrections.md) holds the Reader/Pursue/provenance corrections. Autonomous retrieval is the researcher's separate request, additional to agents #31/#32. Related blocker: core #221.

Validation: **1168 distinct passed, 15 skipped**. Regression cases cover Ask with no role, verifier-gated requests, changed/unknown drafts, preservation of previous snapshots and parsed import scope. Web's public Review-now and Reference-review queue paths are exercised by the coupled suite. [Core offline evidence](https://github.com/DengZhiyuan-math/proof-cli/tree/f77d902ba2f8ccb6b99733d449e53fad85bb897e/docs/audits/2026-10-13-reader-main-target-fix/revision-3).

The coupled candidate suites have **2233 distinct passed, 16 skipped, 0 failed**. Skips cover missing TeX, Windows-only checks and opt-in wall-clock benchmarks. All three wheels build; changed JavaScript passes syntax checks. Ruff retains baseline debt with no new diagnostics. Evidence identifies release bases, candidate parents, actual loaded source paths relative to the development clones, commands and source hashes; those hashes were checked against the commits below.

Provider boundaries are fake. No real Proof provider/model call, literature search, trial service update, pin change, merge, issue closure or Acceptance was performed. Instruction and native-tool tests do not establish real-model literature discovery or mathematical target recognition. The failed #197 project stays evidence; #197 and #132 remain open.

[Preservation manifest](https://github.com/DengZhiyuan-math/proof-cli/blob/f77d902ba2f8ccb6b99733d449e53fad85bb897e/docs/audits/2026-10-13-reader-main-target-fix/revision-3/trial-preservation.json): 134 captured files (130 run-related and 4 later diagnostic files), all unchanged from the first-publication snapshot, not a full run-start environment inventory. Aggregate before/after: `12f3749b60e8fa08086b191003cca45aefbc14ce24188e93641df2dce9a9ee5e`. The prior revision-2 verifier also checks this manifest and optional local trial bytes. Earlier audit artifacts are unchanged.

Coupled source heads: core `f77d902ba2f8ccb6b99733d449e53fad85bb897e`, agents `30b4250554111c22408e3d9784ce0c0b67fb003c`, web `2abb86f0f771e05d75791879823f00ea4f9eb8de`. Integration order is core → agents → web. These PRs remain Draft. CI is separate from this coupled local result: agents CI loads core master; web CI checks packaging and syntax without this full test suite.
core.title: Keep Ask review provenance unconfirmed and scope literature imports

agents.body:
The failed #197 run assigned the project's only Theorem to a supporting bound and downgraded the main result. Reader now identifies the main result before creating any node, reserves theorem kind for it, records supplied statements as departures and stops on DUPLICATE_THEOREM. Single-file turns keep an existing target and report unattached Lemmas as proposals; independent drafts without one target are reported before creation.

Project Pursue checks active coverage after a fresh Reader. Parked, Rejected and detached split Claims stay as historical records and no longer prevent completion or a later Start. Existing standalone work is outside the selected target; newly uncovered active work ends Stuck. Every selected Coordinator must end Done. Missing Theorems, changed roots and mixed Stuck/Budget results retain accurate reasons.

Coverage does **not** identify the mathematical main result. Omitted main results and inverted dependencies can still finish operationally Done; public web probes explicitly preserve that limitation. The Reader brief and a fresh real trial must establish target recognition. No self-reported target file or semantic certificate is used. Related blockers: agents #31 and #32.

Reader, Prover, Decomposer and map discussion share unseeded retrieval instructions: search uncited statements by mathematical content, read primary sources, compare hypotheses/constants/losses/normalisation, and record queries, locators, mismatches and failures. No paper, author, URL, identifier or result was inserted into production briefs. Prover/Decomposer can now place located results on the map and reuse imports through real CLI commands, under their current node only and without Reference-review authority; this requires core #220's parsed guards.

Reader receives at most one quarter of the existing total minutes. Its phase timeout invokes host cancellation, keeps partial work and ends Budget without retry or budget expansion. At a 120-minute total this limits Reader to 30 minutes. Turns still use the shared total.

Validation: **227 distinct passed, 0 skipped**. Regressions use real core split/remove-dependency APIs, single-file Reader CLI creation, fake timeouts, mixed results and changed roots. Both scoped proof roles execute permitted import/reuse commands through the real CLI. Web additionally exercises a scripted Prover import reaching the Reference-review queue. web.body:
The project Pursue host now supplies real map abandonment metadata and persists Reader Budget endings. Existing standalone work does not block the selected target; newly uncovered active work can end Stuck. Old agents without the required map hook are refused before any provider starts.

This is a structural coverage check. It does **not** guarantee that Reader picked the mathematical main theorem. Public-API probes show that omitted main results and inverted dependencies can still report operational Done. The earlier wrong-root claim is removed.

Review-now snapshots the work without confirming its summary for the author. Changed and unknown draft authorship have explicit labels. Legacy author-confirmed records carry a caveat; bound snapshots are not rewritten. This depends on core #220 and agents #30. Web #26's queue-header count is outside this PR.

Validation: **838 distinct passed, 1 skipped**. Public-API cases cover fresh/existing-map coverage, no Coordinator on fresh uncovered work, timeout cancellation with a persisted Budget ending, Review-now provenance and legacy labels. A scripted Prover imports a generic source through real CLI commands; its unreviewed imported result appears in the map and Reference-review queue. This tests the source-to-queue path without performing literature search.
